$doc: Browser capability config. The relay DO bridges agent CDP commands to either the user's real logged-in Chrome (via the extension relay, free-tier) or Cloudflare's managed headless Chromium (@cloudflare/playwright binding, paid plan). The vision flag lives in llm-config.json (it's a model property); this file holds the relay/runtime knobs.

relay.$doc: WebSocket relay between the agent and the browser extension.

managed.$doc: Managed headless target (@cloudflare/playwright). Only used if the BROWSER env binding is present (paid Workers plan). Lazily created on first use; one session reused across calls within a relay instance lifetime.

snapshot.$doc: observe() token-efficiency knobs. observe() returns a compact accessibility-tree YAML (roles + names + refs like [ref=e5]), NOT raw HTML or full body text — the pattern proven by Playwright MCP (~2-5KB per page vs 10-100x for HTML/DOM dumps). maxChars caps the whole tree; maxElements caps node count; readMaxChars caps the lazy browser_read() tool (the model pulls full text only for regions it actually needs); waitForLoadMs is the extra settle time after document.readyState === 'complete' for SPA renders.

distribution.$doc: How users get the extension — drives the Install step of the dashboard's ConnectBrowserCard (surfaced via GET /api/browser/status). 'unpacked' = self-hosted repo install (chrome://extensions → Load unpacked; see extension/README.md); 'store' = Chrome Web Store listing — set storeUrl once published (see docs/extension-store-publishing.md). guideUrl is an optional link to fuller install docs.

safety.$doc: Credentials NEVER touch our system. The agent assumes the user is already logged in via the relay target. observe() detects login walls and STOPS — it never attempts login itself.
